notes: Paths, field names, enums and status codes come from the 1 Oct 2026 service contract (Mert Koç), section 5. Error codes and HTTP statuses come from contract section 4. Every service is POST under https://api.freyabank.example/voice/v1.

The OAuth token endpoint (POST /oauth2/token) is left out as an operation because it is not one of the phone agent's tools. It appears only as the bearerAuth scheme. The test environment does not check the token, headers or `call`.

The contract's section 4 lists 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR, 401 (gateway) and 500 FBE00099 for all services, so every operation includes them. The 404s are service-specific: cards.list FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102, cards.balance FB_IVR_CHANNEL_120, statement.week.get FB_IVR_CHANNEL_121, statement.pdf.send FB_IVR_CHANNEL_107. Per contract section 6, an unknown customer or card on a service without a 404 gets a 400 body.

Card masking: the contract (1 Oct) and the 8 Oct analysis describe masked card numbers. Selin's mail of 9 Oct is the latest, and it says production cards.list returns the full number and only test data is masked. The schema keeps cardNumber as a free string, with the masked example taken from test. The 9 Oct mail also says never to read more than the last four digits.

Statement week limit: the IVR prompt sheet (10 Sep) says once a month and three times a year. Kerem settled it in the 7 Oct session, and the 8 Oct analysis confirms it: once per calendar year. No pre-check service or flag exists yet (contract open point 3), so none is modelled.
The 8 Oct analysis says contact.email.get is called before the offer. The 2 Sep draft had it called only after the caller asked. Contact lookup timing does not change the API shape.
statement.week.change returns statementWeek and statementDay as strings, while statement.week.decide uses statementDueDate rather than lastPayDate. Both are kept exactly as the contract has them.
No client timeout is agreed yet. One test entry carries delaySeconds of more than 10 s and still succeeds.

summary: vaka tahsilat formatında değil (yedi tahsilat tool'u yok): genel yol, workflow'u Claude yazar

notes: Every bank service is called by the engine from an api_request node, never by the model. The request bodies are nested {data:{...}, call:{lang:'tr'}} with values baked from call or code variables. The URL is the base URL plus the contract path.

Code nodes work out every spoken figure and date from the call variable now, never the real clock: Turkish amount words (lira/kuruş, dolar/euro sent, sterlin peni, zero kuruş dropped), currency names in full, the TL paid / unpaid / below-minimum cases, the no-debt sentence that leaves out missing currency blocks, the due date said as 'bugün' when it is today, a due date that has passed, and the day the statement is cut. The reading, the offer, the week preview and the confirmation lines are spoken with fixed TTS from these texts.

Card selection is matched in code: by name, then last four digits, then last six digits, then the full number (first 6 + last 4). An 'all cards' request, a card that is not on the list and a supplementary card each count as a try. A card name that looks like an instruction is replaced by the last four digits. After 3 tries the call goes to the main menu with the failure sentence.

Side-effect calls (statement.pdf.send, statement.week.change) run only after an explicit yes is extracted, and they have maxRetries 0. A hedged answer such as 'olur herhalde' does not count as a yes. Success is decided only from result.code '1' (and exitState for the week change). Each service error goes to the agent sentence the documents give for it.

Global handlers cover: an agent request, payment, a dispute, someone else's card (security sentence, back to the IVR login), a caller who does not speak Turkish, and an out-of-scope question (ask first, then main menu or go back to the step). The model triggers three more as tool calls: three failed tries, the third silence, and still angry after three calming replies.

The statement week change is offered only when it was not already done in this call. The once-a-year line is said before the options. On a joint statement, the line about the linked or main card is said before 'Onaylıyor musunuz?'.
